why: L1.filler-removal, L1.stutter-repetition, L1.false-start-repair: the bulk of everyday clean-up (Daniel, 2026-10-29: "we should have lots of").
behaviour: the speaker is disfluent throughout: filler words (um, uh, erm, like, you know, I mean as filler), immediate repetitions ("the the", "in the. In the. In the transcription"), and abandoned starts restarted straight away ("The reason I think I'm. I'm underscoring this"). Use four to seven of these, spread through the text, and also a 'like' or 'you know' that does carry meaning and must stay ("it looks like rain", "you know the one I mean")
rule: Delete fillers (um, uh, erm, and 'like' / 'you know' / 'I mean' when they carry no meaning; keep them when they do), collapse immediate repetitions to one copy, and remove abandoned starts, keeping only the completed version of the clause. Touch nothing else in those sentences.
